messages.敵を倒すと全員を回復し、パッシブで倒したスキル属性の資源を5つ得られる、資源回収: A Wrath Blunt E.G.O suited to resource gathering, healing everyone on kills and, through its passive, granting 5 resources of the killing skill's Sin.
messages.討伐で全員回復: 敵討伐時に全味方の体力を最大値の10%(解析Ⅲは15%)回復し: **Team heal on kills**: On defeating an enemy, heals all allies by 10% of max HP (15% at Threadspin Ⅲ) and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.止めを刺す設計: 対象の体力が25%未満のときダメージ量が上がる(10%、解析Ⅲ: **Built for finishing**: Deals more damage when the target is below 25% HP (10%, 20% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 40% at Ⅳ). Suited to finishing off enemies below 25% HP.
messages.パッシブ「生贄の儀式」: 攻撃・反撃スキルで敵を倒すと、倒したスキル属性の資源を: **Passive — Live Offering**: Defeating an enemy with an attack or counter skill grants 5 resources of the killing skill's Sin. Its main use is likely farming resources by defeating weak enemies, then funneling them into high-cost E.G.O later.
messages.減算コイン: コイン威力-8の1コインで、マッチ威力は低め。: **Minus Coin**: A single Coin with −8 Coin Power and lowish Clash Power.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 討伐に失敗すると次ターンに出血10を得る(覚醒と条件が逆)。解析Ⅲ: **Corrosion skill**: Gains 10 Bleed next turn if it fails to defeat an enemy (the opposite condition from Awakening). Threadspin Ⅲ also adds 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.雑魚戦で人格スキルや反撃で倒して資源を貯め、強敵に使うE.G.Oの原資にする。: In fights against weak enemies, defeat them with Identity skills or counters to build resources, funding the E.G.O you use against strong enemies.
messages.覚醒そのものの火力は期待しすぎず、止めと回復に使う。: Do not expect too much damage from Awakening itself; use it for finishing blows and healing.
messages.必要資源は憤怒3・色欲2、精神消耗は覚醒20・OC30。: It requires 3 Wrath and 2 Lust, with a Sanity cost of 20 for Awakening and 30 for Overclock.
messages.Ⅱ: 「生贄の儀式」が解放される。パッシブ目的ならここまでで足りる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Live Offering. If the passive is the goal, this is enough.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が24から28、回復量とダメージ補正が増え、侵蝕に攻撃威力増加3が: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 24 to 28, healing and the damage bonus increase, and Corrosion gains 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.Ⅳ: 体力25%未満の補正だけが大きくなる(覚醒40%、侵蝕50%)。侵蝕は味方: **Ⅳ**: Only the bonus against targets below 25% HP grows (40% for Awakening, 50% for Corrosion). Corrosion also increases the risk to allies, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.握らんとする者: S2(色欲)とS3(憤怒)で倒せば、必要資源の色欲・憤怒を回収: **[The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005)**: Defeating enemies with S2 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) recovers the required Lust and Wrath.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S3が憤怒で、倒せば必要資源の憤怒を5つ得られる。: **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:1009)**: His S3 is Wrath, so a kill with it grants 5 of the required Wrath.
